page.overview:
Who is Bihariosaurus?

is an extinct invalid genus of iguanodont ornithopod dinosaur that lived in the Early Cretaceous in what is now Romania. It lived in the Bauxite of Cornet Formation alongside Hypsilophodon.

Bihariosaurus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia section of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006.
